proxy.class.ai.hint: The server sends only your template: model, system prompt and answer length are fixed. Visitors send only the declared fields. Needs the invisible visitor session.
proxy.class.send.hint: A template with the recipient fixed on the server (such as a Telegram bot's chat_id). A session and an anti-robot check on every call.
proxy.class.read.hint: GET and HEAD only, limited per minute and per day. For maps, weather, catalogues.
proxy.class.transparent.hint: Forwards any allowed call. Only for password-protected sites.
proxy.class.transparent.warn: Transparent class: anyone who opens the site can call this API with your key, with any allowed method and path. Keep it only on a password-protected site; otherwise choose AI model, Send a message or Read data.
proxy.budget.paused.text: The endpoint used up its daily budget ({budget} calls) and is paused until midnight UTC. If this is expected traffic, raise the budget in the advanced settings.
proxy.template.only: for AI model and Send a message
proxy.template.hint: JSON: path is the path after the base address, body the request body with {{field}} places, fields the visitor fields with type (string, number, integer, boolean, messages) and length, response the path to the part of the answer to return. No expressions: substitution only.
proxy.advanced.hint: Empty keeps the class defaults. Days are counted in UTC.
proxy.field.daily_budget: Calls per day for the endpoint
err.proxy_session: A visitor session is needed: include /_dropsite/session.js and call dropsite.fetch.
err.proxy_pow: Every call needs a fresh anti-robot check.
err.proxy_field: The request does not match the endpoint's template.
err.proxy_budget: The endpoint's daily budget is used up.
err.proxy_upstream_status: The API service returned an error.
guard.title: Abuse protection
guard.lede: Blocking of AI scrapers and cloud ranges, a global rate limit and IP bans. The API and admin hosts are never blocked, so ChatGPT and Claude connectors keep working.
guard.defender.hint: OpenAI, DeepSeek, GitHub Copilot and Mistral ranges are blocked on every site; AWS, Google Cloud, Azure and Oracle only for calls of the API key proxy.
guard.strict: Strict mode: clouds blocked on whole sites
guard.strict.hint: Visitors with a VPN in a cloud cannot open the sites. Turn it on only during an attack from clouds.
guard.bans.hint: An IP is banned after three violations of the rate limit within 10 minutes or for calls on a schedule: 15 minutes, an hour on a repeat, then a day. IPv6 is banned per /64 network.
